press_references.value: Oman’s first Agentic AI for recruitment launched

product_launches.description: Elevatus officially launched Enfinity, described as Oman’s first hiring Agentic AI embedded in its recruitment platform, enabling autonomous, end-to-end digital hiring workflows for enterprises.

overview_description.description:
Hire at enterprise scale without enterprise complexity.

Since 2019, Elevatus has been rigorously implementing the latest in AI technology and modern science to design award-winning recruiting solutions that are revolutionizing the future of HR. Through these solutions, hundreds of companies from all over the world have been able to hire and assess over 1 million candidates to date. Elevatus helps enterprises, industry giants, startups, and brands from all around the globe centralize their core HR processes under one unified umbrella – to create a faster and more cost-efficient hiring experience. 

Today, Elevatus is a multi-award-winning software company headquartered in Saudi Arabia; with a growing client base, first-class awards, and legions of talented people in our team.

product.name: Enfinity
product.description: An agentic AI hiring operating system that automates and governs recruitment from requisition through onboarding for enterprise and government organizations.

product.name: EVA-REC
product.description: An AI-powered applicant tracking and recruitment platform for sourcing, screening, ranking, managing, and hiring candidates through customizable workflows.

product.name: EVA-SSESS
product.description: An AI video interviewing and assessment platform for conducting scalable, customizable candidate assessments and generating psychometric and job-related insights.

product.name: EVA-BOARD
product.description: An employee onboarding platform for creating paperless, role-based onboarding workflows, assigning responsibilities, and tracking new-hire progress.

product.name: EVA-MED
product.description: A healthcare applicant tracking and recruitment platform for sourcing, screening, hiring, and onboarding medical and healthcare professionals.

product.name: Implementation and Customer Support Services
product.description: Implementation, configuration, integration, and ongoing support services for deploying and operating Elevatus recruitment solutions.
